caption: The drawing depicts a small, ornately decorated wooden cabinet or chest with a rectangular base and a scalloped, arched top. The front features a central arched door made of brown wood with visible vertical grain, secured by two metal hinges and a latch on the left side. The cabinet is elevated on four short, flat feet. The surfaces of the cabinet are painted in a light, creamy beige color and covered with elaborate floral and vine motifs in red, green, yellow, and orange hues, bordered by green and red lines. The floral patterns are distributed across the front, sides, and arch, with symmetrical arrangements and decorative flourishes. The feet and edges have a greenish tint, while the door area above the latch has a green and yellow painted design. The illustration is signed "C. Christoffels" in the bottom right corner. The background is plain and undecorated, focusing attention on the cabinet.
title: Tabernacle (Ecclesiastical Furniture)
